title: Sci-Fi
story: Blast off into a bright future of rockets, saucers and distant planets.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A tall rocket with a pointed nose cone, a round porthole window, three tail fins and a nozzle at the bottom.
cards.hero_colors: white body, red nose cone and fins, small orange porthole rim

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round flying saucer with a wide flat disc body, a glass dome on top and a ring of small lights around the rim.
cards.hero_colors: silver gray disc, light green glass dome, small yellow lights

cards.name: Ringed Planet
cards.subject: A round planet with horizontal bands and one wide flat ring tilted around its middle.
cards.hero_colors: orange and cream planet bands, pale cream ring, one small blue band

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round space helmet with a large curved gold visor, a collar ring at the bottom and two small hose ports on the sides.
cards.hero_colors: white helmet, gold visor, small orange stripe on the collar

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite with a boxy gold body, two long rectangular solar panels on opposite sides and a small round dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold body, dark blue solar panels, small red dish rim

cards.name: Telescope
cards.subject: A telescope with a long white tube, a small finder scope on top and a three-legged tripod.
cards.hero_colors: white tube, brass rings and tripod legs, small red finder scope cap

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A moon rover with a flat open body, six wheels, a tall antenna with a small round dish and a box on the front.
cards.hero_colors: light gray body, black tires, small red antenna dish

cards.name: Space Station
cards.subject: A space station with a long central tube, a cross beam with four large solar panels and round modules attached.
